text: {"lessons":["My trading has not yet shown a reliable edge over the market; I should evaluate performance over many periods, including cash and realized gains, rather than infer skill from a few wins.","Selling at a loss or taking a profit without a consistent thesis and risk plan can make my decisions reactive; I should define entry reasons, position limits, and exit conditions before trading.","Frequent changes across several stocks can add complexity without clear benefit; I should preserve diversification and cash, and trade only when the expected improvement justifies changing my holdings."]}
